newsitem.title: INDIA: GE unit to buy control of India SRF Finance.
newsitem.headline: GE unit to buy control of India SRF Finance.

text.p: GE Capital Services, a unit of U.S.-based General Electric Co, said on Tuesday it reached an agreement with India's SRF Ltd to buy a majority stake in SRF Finance Ltd.

GE Capital said in a statement released in the Indian capital that the deal would require approval from the government's Foreign Investment Promotion Board (FIPB) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI).
It did not indicate the size of the majority stake nor how much it would pay tyre cord maker SRF.

The statement said GE Capital, after acquiring a majority, would launch a public offer for the remaining shares of the company in accordance with regulatory guidelines at the same price it negotiated with the sellers.
SRF spokeswoman Meenakshi Seth told Reuters that the financial details would be disclosed later on Tuesday at a news conference scheduled for 4 p.m. (1030 GMT) in New Delhi.
"The transaction allows SRF to focus on its core businesses and allows GE Capital to signficantly expand its presence in commercial vehicle and working capital financing," the statement said.
SRF is a leading Indian company in the field of nylon tyre cords, fabrics and fluorochemicals with some interests in engineering plastics, polyester films and eye lenses.
GE Capital Services, with assets of $200 billion, is a global, diversified financial services company.
